prompt: A photorealistic photo captures the chaotic energy of a beach volleyball tournament under bright sunlight. In the center foreground, a player in blue shorts leaps high to spike the ball, his muscles tensed and eyes focused downward. To his left, a teammate in a yellow visor stands ready with arms raised, watching the trajectory intently. On the right side of the net, an opponent in black sunglasses dives into the sand, kicking up a small cloud of dust as he attempts a save. Behind the diving player, a referee in a striped shirt sits on a tall white chair, observing the play with a stern expression. Next to the referee, a scorekeeper in a pink hat holds a clipboard, pen poised to mark the point. Near the baseline, a coach in a green polo points aggressively toward the court, shouting instructions to his team. Beside the coach, a water boy in gray sneakers holds out a plastic bottle, waiting for a break. In the background crowd, a woman in a floral dress claps her hands enthusiastically while standing next to a man in a denim jacket who checks his watch impatiently. A child in red swim trunks runs past them, chasing a stray brown dog that bounds joyfully across the sand. Further back, a vendor in an orange apron hands a hot dog to a spectator in a baseball cap. Nearby, a couple shares a large umbrella; the person in the white shirt leans against the person in the striped tank top, both shielding their eyes from the glare. A cooler sits on the sand next to the umbrella, its lid slightly ajar. A volleyball rests on the ground near the net post, forgotten in the heat of the moment. A towel lies crumpled beside the cooler, partially buried in the sand. A pair of flip-flops is discarded near the boundary line, left behind by a hurried player. There is no scoreboard visible in the frame. There is no ocean horizon line shown. There is no text or signage on any clothing.
